description: This file contains utility functions for mapping statuses and strings to color representations, used for consistent visual theming in a dashboard. It includes functions to generate deterministic pastel colors from strings and to assign theme-defined colors to common statuses or categories.

methods.name: colorFromString
methods.description: Deterministically generates a pastel-like HSL color based on an input string. Uses a string hash to produce distinct hue values while maintaining consistent saturation and lightness for dark backgrounds.

methods.name: getStatusColor
methods.description: Maps status labels to theme-specific colors, providing fallbacks to deterministic colors for unknown statuses. Recognizes common status categories like processing, success, failure, and unknown, and returns appropriate color codes.
